assertions.assertion: The member has a history of recurrent episodes of palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis code I47.1 is assigned for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis code R55 is assigned for presyncope/syncope symptoms
Cardiac event monitoring is performed using CPT 93271
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary for ambulatory evaluation of the arrhythmia
The service captures the cardiac rhythm during symptomatic episodes
The claim for cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) was denied
The denial is based on reason code PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The member has the right to appeal the denial
